description: This file defines the ValidKeysConstraintValidator class, which validates configuration keys against allowed and dynamically valid keys within Drupal's validation system. It includes methods for validation logic, handling dynamic types, and generating violation messages.

classes.name: ValidKeysConstraintValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the ValidKeys constraint, responsible for validating configuration keys against allowed and dynamically valid keys, and handling violations accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of a given value against the ValidKeys constraint, checking for invalid keys, missing required keys, and handling dynamic type considerations.

methods.name: getDynamicMessageParameters
methods.description: Generates message parameters for violations related to dynamic type resolution, including unresolved and resolved dynamic types, property paths, and values.
